entities.summary: Yuri Ivanovych Khymych was a Soviet, Ukrainian architect and artist, an outstanding master of the architectural landscape, a classic of the Ukrainian fine arts of the 20th century, a teacher. Honored Artist and Architect of Ukraine, member of the National Union of Architects of Ukraine (1955), member of the National Union of Artists of Ukraine (1962), Honored Artist of the Ukrainian SSR (1990), honorary member of the Academy of Architecture of Ukraine. In the late 50s of the twentieth century, among art historians, he gained fame as one of the best watercolorists of the USSR of that time..
